next.reason: 1985: 'The COPY statement must be preceded by a space and terminated by the separator period', with no exception. §2023:7.2.3.3 SR2: 'A COPY statement shall be preceded by a space except when it is the first statement in a compilation group' - a case 1985 refused is accepted. The terminating period is kept: the format §2023:7.2.3.2 ends with it and §2023:7.2.3.4 GR6 replaces the statement 'ending with the separator period, inclusive'. Looser.
